results.text: Effect of empagliflozin on fractional excretion of sodium in patients with cirrhosis and refractory ascites. Ascites is the most common complication of cirrhosis. Empagliflozin Enhances Hepatic Glucose Production and Reduces Total-Body Norepinephrine Turnover Rate: A Randomized Trial. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) cause an increase in hepatic glucose production (HGP). We previously showed that SGLT2i cause a rapid (within 4 h) increase in the total-body norepinephrine (NE) turnover rate, which could explain the increase in HGP.
